data.additionalInfo:
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
- Adults may only visit the attraction when accompanied by a child. Entry will be denied otherwise, and no refunds will be issued.

Child policy:
- Children under 2 years are free of charge when accompanied by a paying adult. 
- Children below 8 years must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.
- Children between 8 to 17 years are allowed to enter without an adult but must have an adult present upon entrance and exit of the attraction.

data.address: KidZania Kuala Lumpur Mutiara Damansara Petaling Jaya Selangor Malaysia
data.description: KidZania Kuala Lumpur is an interactive indoor theme park, where children can experience real-life jobs in a role-playing environment. The child-geared activity centre comes complete with a functioning economy, paved streets, moving vehicles, and buildings. KidZania offers around 70 role-playing activities where they'll learn all about jobs, money and the real world while developing life skills that simply cannot be taught in the classroom.
